# T003 frontend characterization

## Summary

Characterized existing frontend transaction and call-service behavior offline, without changing product code. The root test suite now discovers 35 tests versus 15 after T002.

## Changes

- `frontend/tests/transaction-formatting.test.ts`: five additional cases (10 total) pin literal currency versus spoken `Intl.NumberFormat` output, merchant fallback, deterministic IDs, `parseFloat` creation and pending audit/time fields, and immutable audit/status/metadata transitions. The five earlier formatting tests remain.
- `frontend/tests/call-service.test.ts`: 15 offline cases cover default/configured URL and POST payload; initiation/dialing audit and time; sparse backend defaults, subscription replay and merge precedence; two-second polling and six terminal states; JSON/plain-text/network failures, failed-initiation polling, and retry audit/count. All fetch calls use a stub; clocks, environment, fetch and console spies are restored. No live backend or Azure requests.

## Decisions

- The approved T003 block in `plan.md` calls for tests of the unchanged implementation rather than changes to source. Preserve oddities: connection ID goes into audit metadata but not the transaction field; a failed initiation rebuilds audit from the input transaction; an existing subscription keeps polling after failure; a sparse first poll defaults currency to USD and merchant to `merchantName`.
- Use a fixed 2025-01-02 UTC clock, fake polling timers and controlled locale/time zone for reliable snapshots. The pre-existing lint error in an empty test callback was corrected without reducing coverage.

## Validation

Node 22.23.3, npm 10.9.9, Linux. Exact ordered root gates after the test edits: `npm ci` passed (934 installed; 56 existing vulnerable package entries); `npm run build --if-present` passed (three existing CSS optimizer warnings); `npm test` passed; `npm run lint --if-present` passed (five existing warnings, zero errors); `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json` passed. The full gate sequence was repeated after this progress-note edit.

Machine-readable reports in ignored `.modernization-scratch/`: `T003-backend.xml` from `TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 node --test --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=.modernization-scratch/T003-backend.xml backend/tests/*.test.js` and `T003-frontend.xml` from `TZ=UTC LANG=C.UTF-8 npm run test --workspace frontend -- --reporter=junit --outputFile=../.modernization-scratch/T003-frontend.xml`. Parsed `<testcase>` totals: backend **10 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped**, frontend **25 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped**; root total **35 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped**, up from T002's 15. No workspace is missing.

## Follow-ups and risks

The tests are isolated unit characterization, not proof of an actual browser/backend/Azure call. Existing CSS/lint warnings and dependency advisories remain for later tasks. No product files, dependencies or locks changed.
